title: Nyumbani na familia
description: Ten short, simple stories about home, family and everyday moments in East Africa.

lessons.title: Mama na mtoto
lessons.summary: Asha tells her son Salim that she loves him very much; Salim loves his mother too.
lessons.text:
Asha ni mama. Asha ana mtoto mmoja. Mtoto wake ni Salim. Salim ni mtoto mzuri sana. Mama anampenda Salim sana.

"Salim, wewe ni mtoto wangu," mama anasema. "Mimi ni mama yako. Ninakupenda sana."

"Mimi pia ninakupenda, mama," Salim anasema. "Mimi ni mtoto wako, na wewe ni mama yangu. Wewe ni mama mzuri sana."

"Na wewe pia ni mtoto mzuri," mama anasema.

Mama anampenda mtoto wake. Mtoto anampenda mama yake. Wote wanasema, "Ninakupenda sana."

Maswali:
Mtoto wa Asha ni Salim?
Ndiyo, mtoto wa Asha ni Salim.
Mama anasema nini?
Mama anasema, "Ninakupenda sana."
Salim anasema nini kuhusu mama yake?
Salim anasema, "Wewe ni mama mzuri sana."
Salim anampenda mama yake?
Ndiyo, Salim anampenda mama yake sana.

lessons.title: Baba anakuja kutoka kazini
lessons.summary: Every day Hamisi goes to work; today he comes back from work and tells his child what he does there.
lessons.text:
Hamisi ni baba. Kila siku anakwenda kazini. Anafanya kazi sana. Anapenda kazi yake.

Leo baba anatoka kazini. Sasa anakuja kutoka kazini kwa mtoto wake.

"Baba amekuja!" mtoto wake anasema.

"Ndiyo, nimekuja," baba anasema. "Leo nimefanya kazi sana. Sasa niko hapa na wewe."

"Baba, unafanya nini kazini?" mtoto anasema.

"Ninafanya vitu vingi," baba anasema. "Kila siku ninakwenda kazini, ninafanya kazi, na ninatoka kazini. Na kila siku ninakuja kwako."

Kila siku ni hivyo. Baba anakwenda kazini na anakuja kutoka kazini. Sasa yuko pamoja na mtoto wake.

Maswali:
Hamisi anafanya nini kila siku?
Kila siku Hamisi anakwenda kazini na anafanya kazi.
Leo baba anakuja kutoka kazini?
Ndiyo, leo baba anakuja kutoka kazini.
Mtoto anasema nini?
Mtoto anasema, "Baba amekuja!"
Baba anapenda kazi yake?
Ndiyo, baba anapenda kazi yake.

lessons.title: Kitu kikubwa
lessons.summary: Saida sees a big thing up high in the house and calls her friend Fatuma; inside it is another, smaller thing.
lessons.text:
Saida yuko ndani. Anaona kitu kikubwa juu. "Fatuma, njoo hapa!" anasema. "Ona kitu hiki!"

Fatuma anakuja hapa. "Kitu kikubwa kiko wapi?" anasema.

"Kiko juu, kwenye kitu kile," Saida anasema. "Ni kikubwa sana."

Fatuma anaona kitu hicho. "Ni kitu cha mama," anasema. "Mama ana vitu vingi kama hiki."

Wanakichukua kitu hicho. Ndani yake kuna kitu kingine.

"Ona, katika kitu hiki kikubwa kuna kitu kingine!" Saida anasema.

"Ndiyo," Fatuma anasema. "Na kwenye kitu hicho kuna jina la mama."

Wanakiacha kitu kikubwa katika eneo lake, juu.

Maswali:
Saida anaona nini?
Saida anaona kitu kikubwa juu.
Kitu kikubwa ni cha nani?
Kitu kikubwa ni cha mama.
Ndani ya kitu kikubwa kuna nini?
Ndani yake kuna kitu kingine.
Kwenye kitu hicho kuna nini?
Kwenye kitu hicho kuna jina la mama.

lessons.title: Kitu cha baba
lessons.summary: Daudi wants to take his father's thing; his father gives him another one instead.
lessons.text:
Daudi ni mtoto. Anataka kitu kimoja cha baba yake.

"Baba, ninataka kitu chako," Daudi anasema. "Naweza kukichukua?"

"La," baba anasema. "Kitu hiki ni cha baba yako. Lakini ninaweza kukupa kitu kingine."

"Kitu kingine kama hiki?" Daudi anasema.

Baba anatoa vitu vingine. "Unataka kitu hiki au kitu kile? Au unataka vitu vyote?"

"Ninataka kitu hiki tu," Daudi anasema. "Ni kizuri kama kitu chako, lakini ni changu."

Baba anampa Daudi kitu kimoja. Daudi anachukua kitu hicho. Amepata kitu kizuri.

"Sasa nina kitu kama wewe, baba," Daudi anasema.

Maswali:
Daudi anataka nini?
Daudi anataka kitu kimoja cha baba yake.
Baba anasema nini?
Baba anasema, "Ninaweza kukupa kitu kingine."
Baba anatoa nini?
Baba anatoa vitu vingine.
Daudi amepata nini?
Daudi amepata kitu kizuri kama kitu cha baba.

lessons.title: Siku ya mama
lessons.summary: Once a year all of Mariamu's children come to her with their own children for her day.
lessons.text:
Mariamu ni mama wa watoto wengi. Kila mwaka kuna siku ya mama. Leo ni siku hiyo.

Watoto wake wote wanakuja kwake. Wanakuja pamoja na watoto wao. Kuna watu wengi sana.

"Mama yetu, leo ni siku yako," mtoto mmoja anasema. "Wote tuko pamoja kwa sababu yako. Wewe ni maisha yetu."

Watu wote wanakula pamoja. Watoto wanafanya vitu vingi pamoja na mama yao.

Mama anaona watoto wake wote na watoto wao. "Wote ni watoto wangu," anasema. "Mwaka huu ni mzuri sana kwa sababu tuko pamoja."

Kila mwaka watoto wote wanakuja kwa mama yao, pamoja na watoto wao.

Maswali:
Leo ni siku ya nani?
Leo ni siku ya mama.
Watoto wa Mariamu wanakuja pamoja na watoto wao?
Ndiyo, watoto wake wote wanakuja pamoja na watoto wao.
Kuna watu wengi?
Ndiyo, kuna watu wengi sana.
Mama anasema nini?
Mama anasema, "Wote ni watoto wangu."

lessons.title: Kazi za baba
lessons.summary: Yusufu wants to do his father's work but does not know how; his father shows him first, and after a while he can.
lessons.text:
Yusufu ni mtoto. Baba wa Yusufu ana kazi nyingi. Yusufu anataka kufanya kazi za baba. Lakini hajui kazi hizo.

"Baba, sijui kufanya kazi zako," anasema. "Kazi hizi si kazi za mtoto."

"Unaweza," baba anasema. "Kwanza ona. Mimi nitafanya, na wewe utaona."

Baba anafanya kazi kwanza. Yusufu anaona. Baada ya hapo Yusufu anafanya kazi hiyo.

"Sasa nini?" anasema.

"Sasa endelea kwa muda," baba anasema. "Endelea hadi nikwambie."

Yusufu anaendelea kwa muda, hadi baba anasema, "Basi! Sasa unajua kazi hii."

"Ndiyo, sasa ninajua!" Yusufu anasema. "Ninaweza kufanya kazi za baba!"

"Wewe si mtoto tu, wewe ni mtoto wa kazi," baba anasema. "Sasa una kazi kama mimi."

Maswali:
Yusufu anataka kufanya nini?
Yusufu anataka kufanya kazi za baba.
Baba anafanya nini kwanza?
Kwanza baba anafanya kazi, na Yusufu anaona.
Yusufu anasema nini baada ya muda?
Anasema, "Ninaweza kufanya kazi za baba!"
Yusufu anajua kazi hii sasa?
Ndiyo, sasa Yusufu anajua kazi hii.

lessons.title: Siku ya kwanza ya kazi
lessons.summary: Halima starts a new job; at first it is hard, but she goes on, and in the end it goes well.
lessons.text:
Leo Halima anaanza kazi. Ni siku yake ya kwanza.

Mara ya kwanza kazi si rahisi. Halima hajui vitu vingi. Lakini anaendelea tu.

Wakati mmoja mtu wa kazi anasema, "Halima, unaweza kuendelea bila mimi?"

"Sawa," Halima anasema. "Ninaweza kuendelea bila wewe."

Anaendelea na kazi. Hata wakati kazi ni kubwa, anaendelea tu. Anafanya zaidi na zaidi.

Wakati kazi imekwisha, mtu yule anakuja. "Basi, umeanza vizuri sana," anasema. "Sawa kabisa."

"Asante," Halima anasema. "Nitaendelea zaidi."

Maswali:
Halima anaanza nini leo?
Halima anaanza kazi leo.
Mara ya kwanza kazi ni rahisi?
Hapana, mara ya kwanza kazi si rahisi.
Halima anafanya nini hata wakati kazi ni kubwa?
Hata wakati kazi ni kubwa, Halima anaendelea tu.
Mtu wa kazi anasema nini?
Anasema, "Basi, umeanza vizuri sana."

lessons.title: Mfalme na watoto
lessons.summary: A father tells his son a story about a king who loved the children of his country.
lessons.text:
Baba yake Said anamwambia kitu kuhusu mfalme mmoja. "Mfalme yule alikuwa na nchi kubwa," anasema.

"Mfalme alipenda nchi yake?" Said anasema.

"Ndiyo," baba anasema. "Alipenda nchi yake kwa sababu ya watu wake. Alisema kwamba watoto ni maisha ya nchi."

"Kwa nini?" Said anasema.

"Kwa sababu watoto wataendelea na maisha ya nchi," baba anamwambia. "Hivyo mfalme aliwapa watoto kazi ili wajue vitu vingi."

Said anafikiri. "Basi mimi pia nitajua vitu vingi," anasema. "Ni hivyo?"

"Ndiyo," baba anamwambia. "Hiyo ndiyo sababu ninakwambia kuhusu mfalme yule."

Maswali:
Baba anamwambia Said kuhusu nini?
Baba anamwambia Said kuhusu mfalme mmoja.
Mfalme alikuwa na nini?
Mfalme alikuwa na nchi kubwa.
Mfalme alisema nini kuhusu watoto?
Mfalme alisema kwamba watoto ni maisha ya nchi.
Kwa nini mfalme aliwapa watoto kazi?
Aliwapa watoto kazi ili wajue vitu vingi.

lessons.title: Mama anafikiri
lessons.summary: Kassim's mother is not well; she thinks about which work to leave to her children while she goes out.
lessons.text:
Fatuma ni mama wa Kassim. Wako katika eneo lenye watu wengi. Leo hali ya Fatuma si nzuri.

Fatuma ana kazi nyingi. Kuna kazi ambayo anaifanya kila siku. Kuna kazi ambayo watoto wanaweza kuifanya.

Fatuma anafikiri sana. "Nitaacha kazi ambayo watoto wanaweza kuifanya," anafikiri. "Na mimi nitakwenda katikati ya eneo letu."

Anawaacha watoto wake, ambao wako pamoja na baba yao. Watoto ambao ni wakubwa wanafanya kazi. Wanatumia vitu vya kazi vya mama yao.

Fatuma anakuja kutoka katikati ya eneo lao. "Mko sawa?" anasema.

"Ndiyo, mama, tuko sawa," Kassim anasema. "Tumetumia vitu vyako. Na hali yako?"

"Hali yangu ni sawa sasa," mama anasema.

Maswali:
Fatuma na Kassim wako katika eneo gani?
Wako katika eneo lenye watu wengi.
Fatuma anaacha kazi gani?
Anaacha kazi ambayo watoto wanaweza kuifanya.
Watoto wako na baba yao?
Ndiyo, watoto wako pamoja na baba yao.
Watoto wanatumia nini?
Wanatumia vitu vya kazi vya mama yao.

lessons.title: Maua ya mama
lessons.summary: Asha gives her mother flowers; her mother asks whether they are really for her, and Asha says yes.
lessons.text:
Asha ni mtoto. Leo ana maua mengi. Maua hayo ni ya mama yake.

"Mama, ona maua haya!" Asha anasema. "Ni yako."

"Ndiyo? Maua hayo ni yangu?" mama anasema.

"Ndiyo, mama," Asha anasema. "Ni maua mazuri sana kwa mama mzuri."

Mama anachukua maua. "Asante sana, mtoto wangu," anasema. "Ua hili ni zuri, na ua lile pia."

Baada ya hapo wanakula pamoja. "Kula, Asha," mama anasema. "Hiki ni chakula cha mtoto wangu, na kile ni chakula cha mama."

"Ndiyo, mama," Asha anasema. Anakula, na mama anaona maua yake.

Maswali:
Asha ana nini leo?
Asha ana maua mengi leo.
Maua ni ya mama yake?
Ndiyo, maua ni ya mama yake.
Mama anasema nini kuhusu maua?
Mama anasema, "Ua hili ni zuri, na ua lile pia."
Asha anasema nini kwa mama?
Asha anasema, "Ndiyo, mama."
